title: LGD-Eval — Independent Evaluation for the Age of Autonomous Agents
description: Independent third-party evaluation institution for autonomous systems, tools, skills and agents. Evaluates autonomy and verifies governance claims with evidence-grade conclusions, bias-controlled LLM judging (position swap, style normalization, kappa reporting), and mappings to OWASP / NIST / ISO / MITRE / EU AI Act standards. Five repos: profile home, protocol, reports, evidence vault, skill-audit scanner. / 凡自治之物的独立中立评测机构：以证据分级结论、偏倚可控的判官体系与标准映射，评测自治之物，验证治理主张。五仓：首页、评测协议、评测报告、存证库、技能审计工具。
